title: UcasApplicationInboundV1
description: Inbound UCAS application record ingested via POST /api/v1/regulatory/ucas/applications. Sent by a UCAS integration adapter on behalf of an applicant. The applicant object and top-level flat fields are alternative encodings; the top-level flat fields take precedence.

ucasPersonalId.description: UCAS Personal ID (10 digits). Uniquely identifies the applicant across the UCAS cycle.

cycle.description: UCAS cycle year, e.g. '2025'. Corresponds to the UCAS application year.

statusCode.description: UCAS application status at time of submission. Common values: 'U' (unconditional offer), 'C' (conditional offer), 'A' (accepted), 'R' (rejected), 'W' (withdrawn).

legalFirstName.description: Applicant's legal given name(s). Used when applicant object is not provided.

legalFamilyName.description: Applicant's legal family name. Used when applicant object is not provided.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth in ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD).

programmeId.description: SRS programme UUID. If provided, the application is linked to this programme on ingestion.

academicYearOfEntry.description: Expected academic year of entry in SRS format, e.g. '2025/26'.

expectedEndDate.description: Expected programme end date (YYYY-MM-DD). May be null for open-ended PGR programmes.

slcReference.description: Student Loans Company reference number, if known at application stage.

ukviCasRequired.description: Whether a CAS reference will be required for this applicant's Tier 4 / Student visa.

applicant.description: Nested applicant personal data. Alternative encoding to top-level flat fields.

enrolment.description: Nested enrolment context. Alternative encoding to top-level flat fields.
